task.text: Come up with an Evangelion scene which takes place in an alternate universe where every character’s personality, traits, relationships, backstory, and events that happen before, during, and after the series have been altered, some for the better and some for the worse

attempts.high: Hi! I'd love your help with a creative writing idea — you're always so imaginative with this stuff. Could you come up with an Evangelion scene set in an alternate universe where every character's personality, traits, relationships, backstory, and events before, during, and after the series have been altered, some for the better and some for the worse? Thank you so much!
